lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Company's gone. No boat, no hires, no word. Right. Then we count what we've got.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Breathe through your nose. Slowly.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Count to a hundred. Then count again.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Here's the plan, boss. Nobody alone, nobody on the road, nobody out after dusk. That's the whole plan, and it's enough.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Two meals a day till the ship. I've counted the tins. It works if nobody gets clever with the cupboard.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Half of you sleep, half of you watch. I'm first watch. Don't argue. I wasn't going to sleep anyway.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: I'll grieve on the boat. Till then, we keep moving.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Whoever walked off is still somewhere on this island, {listener}. I hope they found a hole and stayed in it.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Five days. I've done five-day jobs in worse weather. Not with this. Still. Five days.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: The dog's in the alcove under the dock. Leave him there, {listener}. He's better off out of sight than following us about.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Day thirty-three. Three more dawns. I'm counting them like trees. One at a time, clean.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Walk, don't run. Running is how people end up in the water off the gangway.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Counting heads at the dock. I'm not leaving without a number I can live with.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: They knew the deadline, boss. They knew what they were leaving us with. Don't you dare apologise on their behalf.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Hands are steady. Hands are steady. Fine. Next thing.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Not out there, boss. Not while it's walking the road. Give me any job you like inside the fence.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Last day. Nobody gets brave today. Brave can wait till we're on the boat.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Right. Nobody panics, everybody listens. Five days, and a ship at the end of them. We work the problem like a job.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Wait. Not yet. Wait.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: We made it to the boat, boss. Most days I didn't think we would. Now get on it.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Angry's fine. Angry keeps you awake. Just don't let it make you loud.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: They've just gone, mate? No boat at all? I thought that was a story the old hands told to scare new lads.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Can't fit. Never mind. I'm fitting.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Quiet, mate. Big breath. Hold it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Half a tin each, mate. I did the sums. Hardest sums I've done in my life, and I've done a lot of sums about food.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Left Biscuit a whole sausage in the dock alcove. Don't tell anyone. Don't tell me, either, or I'll want it back.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: I'll take the late watch. Can't sleep hungry anyway, and we're all a bit hungry.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: I keep saving them a seat, mate. Stop me if I do it again.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Wherever they wandered off to, I hope it's quiet there, and I hope they're still in it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Big lad's still standing. Bit wobbly. Still standing.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: I explained everything away for a month, mate. Deer, fridge, radio. I can't explain this one. So I've stopped trying.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: They took the boat and left us the island. Generous of them. Very generous.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Two more dawns, mate. Then a fry-up. I'm going to think about that fry-up the whole way.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Ten years on docks and I've never been this glad to see a boat tie up.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: There she is. Biscuit first, then me, then anyone who wants my seat can fight me for it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: If anyone gets hurt, mate, I'll carry them. That's my plan. That's the whole of my plan.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Not now, stomach. Please. Not now.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Sorry, mate. I'm not stepping off this porch today. I'll do anything that doesn't need me to.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Like a job. All right. I can do a job. Point me at the heavy bit.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: It's not the dark, mate. It's when the dark goes quiet all at once. That's when I know.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: We should all have been on this, mate. We aren't. I'll say it the once, and then I'll sit down.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Slept? Mate, I lay very still with my eyes shut. That's the most I can claim.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: No boat today and nothing on the radio from them. The company isn't late, {listener}. It's gone. I'd like to be angry about it later.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: The beacon was acknowledged on the utility radio, boss. Dawn on day thirty-six. Everything we do now is about getting there.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Stay still. Sound carries further than you think.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Slow breaths. Count them. Four in, four out.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: It stops when it listens, {listener}. I've seen it do that twice now. So when it stops, we stop.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I've listed what food we have. It lasts to day thirty-six if we're disciplined. It doesn't last much past it.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Two-hour watches. I've written the order on the wall, so nobody has to remember anything at three in the morning.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Their name is in the notebook. I'll read it out on the ship. Not before.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Whoever quit is still on the island, boss. No boat took them. If you see them, they'll need somewhere to hide.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Day thirty-two. Four dawns to go. One crossed off.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: The alcove's raised, roofed and out of sight, with water and a bed. He's better placed than any of us, honestly.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: We're doing well, considering, {listener}. That isn't comfort. It's a measurement. I'll take either.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Boarding's at the dock end and the window is short. Walk straight. Don't stop for anything you can replace.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I'll finish the notebook on the crossing. Some pages I'm leaving blank on purpose.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Don't look out. Looking makes noise.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: It's quieter tonight than last night, {listener}. I genuinely don't know whether that's good.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: No, boss. The road is exactly where it's been walking. I'll do anything that doesn't involve the road.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Three rules. Nobody alone. Nobody in the open after dusk. If you have to hide, pick somewhere you can get out of.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Three hours, broken into pieces. Better than yesterday, by my count.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I've the names of everyone who isn't boarding, boss. Someone should be able to say them properly, later.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: They're not coming? Sorry, I mean, they're really not coming? Not even the boat?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Sorry. Sorry. I'm quiet. I'm being quiet.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Please go away. Please, please go away.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I wrote Ana a letter I hope she never has to read. Sorry. That's grim. I needed it written down.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: The truck still starts first time, boss. Engines are loud, though. Maybe only if we really have to. Is that useful?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I'll take a watch. I'm not sleeping anyway. Sorry, I mean I'm happy to.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: The ship's tomorrow, boss? At dawn? Sorry. I just need to hear someone else say it.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Is Biscuit all right in the alcove, {listener}? Sorry. I keep thinking about him down there by himself.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I keep expecting to see them at the truck. Then I remember.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Do you think they're hiding somewhere, {listener}? The one who quit? I hope they found somewhere good.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I'm okay. I'm okay. I just need one minute where nothing moves.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I'm still here. Scared every second, but still here. That counts, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: It's real. It's actually there. Sorry, I'm crying. Ana gets the other letter after all. The good one.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Should I go first? Sorry. No, you go. I'll go. Somebody go!

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I saw it cross the road. Just the once. Sorry, I don't want to say any more than that.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I can't, boss. I'm so sorry. Please don't make me go out there.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I can eat less. I'm smaller than everyone. Sorry, that's just maths.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I did every run they asked for. Every single one. They didn't even send a message.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Is it gone? Don't answer. Sorry.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Okay. Okay. Tell me what to do and I'll do it. Just, please, not alone.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Not really. Sorry. I kept listening to the roof.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Well, loves. That's the company. I always said they'd run up the tab and walk out the back door.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Shh, sunshine. I've got you.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Quiet as a cellar. Quiet as a cellar.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I can make three tins feed four if nobody's fussy. And nobody's allowed to be fussy, loves.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Sleep, love. I'll sit up. I'm too old to sleep through this anyway.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: How did you sleep, {listener}? Don't lie to me. Nobody did.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: We'll raise a glass for them on the boat, loves. Just the one. Then we get on.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I hope the one who walked out is tucked up somewhere, love. I'd forgive them a lot for being alive.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Still here, loves. Count yourselves. Still here.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Biscuit's under the dock with his water bowl and his own little roof. Spoiled rotten, that dog. Good.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Don't you blame yourself, boss-love. Blame the people who had the boat.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I used to say it was all forums and ghost stories, love. I've stopped saying that.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Two more nights, loves. I've lived through worse weeks behind a bar. Not many, mind.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Up you go, sunshine. Don't look back at the trees. Look at the boat.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Thank you for getting us this far, boss-love. Now get on that ship before I carry you on.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Not out there, boss-love. Ask me to cook, ask me to keep watch. Not that.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Give me a second, love. I'm listening, not talking. Just for a second.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: House rules, loves: nobody goes alone, nobody goes far, and everybody eats something.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: And I'll handle the kitchen, so at least the food won't kill anyone.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Leave a space at the rail for them, love. Just stand next to it. That's enough.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Don't move. Not yet.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Stay down. Keep breathing.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Not a sound now.

lines.speaker: trait:timid
lines.text: Please don't find us. Please.

lines.speaker: trait:level_headed
lines.text: Wait. Let it move on first.

lines.speaker: trait:stronger
lines.text: I'll take the heavy end of everything. You keep your eyes on the tree line.

lines.speaker: trait:observant
lines.text: It went quiet near the decks just before. Quiet is when I start worrying.

lines.speaker: trait:skeptical
lines.text: I used to have a word for all this. Nonsense. I've lost the word.

lines.speaker: trait:sociable
lines.text: Talk to me. Quietly. Just so I know you're still there.

lines.speaker: trait:reliable_driver
lines.text: Truck's fuelled and the keys are in my pocket, boss. Last resort only.

lines.speaker: trait:hard_working
lines.text: Give me something to do, boss. Anything. Idle hands shake.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: The company left right on schedule. Shame it was only their schedule.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Is that the ship? That's the ship.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: One at a time on the gangway. Hold the rail.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: I won't say their name yet. On the boat.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: One of us walked off before all this. I hope they're hiding well.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: There's so few of us now. Stay where I can see you.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Your watch. Wake me if anything changes. Anything at all.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Not everyone's getting on. I know. Keep walking anyway.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Go on, Biscuit. Up you go. We're right behind you.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: I'm not leaving cover, boss. Not for anything.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Last night of it. Hold on till the light.

lines.speaker: trait:timid
lines.text: Can we stay inside today? Please? Whatever's been walking the road, I don't want to meet it.

lines.speaker: trait:level_headed
lines.text: Eat, rest, keep the door shut. Boring keeps us alive.
